## Sandbox: gh and git push
Only `gh *` and `git push *` run outside the sandbox, and only as a single plain Bash call. A `cd` first, chaining (&&, ;, |), a redirect, a heredoc or pipe into stdin, $(...), `git -C`, or calling gh from Python/a script keeps the call sandboxed, where gh fails with 401/"token invalid" and git push with "could not read Username". Run them from the repo's working directory, pass PR bodies and API payloads with --body-file <file> / --input <file>, and don't conclude they can't work until a plain call has failed.
